topic: Why Breaking the Law Is Profitable

topic_details.title: Why Breaking the Law Is Profitable
topic_details.angle: For the biggest companies, fines are a line item — they budget for breaking the law because the penalty is always less than the profit. RealPage ($0 fine this week), Meta ($5B = 9% of revenue), Boeing (346 dead = 11 days revenue), AI scraping wars (scrape now, pay later, keep the model).
